notes: All requirements met: 6 quantile classes computed from data, YlOrRd sequential scheme, white 0.5px outlines, Positron light basemap, exact initial view, tooltip with valuePerSqm and growth, HTML legend with numeric breaks (bodyText shows '0 – 1,337 … > 6,883').

Uses dated deck.gl 8.9.35 via `new deck.DeckGL({mapLib: maplibregl, mapStyle})` rather than v9 MapboxOverlay/addControl; v8 standalone also triggered a blocked mapbox-gl.css request (harmless since maplibre CSS is loaded separately).
Cartography is clean and legible; minor nitpicks: lightest class is low-contrast against the pale basemap and the top class label hides the max value ('> 6,883').
